references.text: The same five Amorite kings are mentioned again when they gather against Gibeon
The five kings are found hidden in the cave at Makkedah
List of defeated kings, including the kings of Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish, and Eglon
Jerusalem is mentioned as a city where the Jebusites lived
Melchizedek was king in Salem (Jerusalem), and Adoni-Zedek means 'my lord is righteousness' - possible connection to the royal title in Jerusalem
Hebron is mentioned as a city where the descendants of Anak lived
Lachish is mentioned as a city in Judah's inheritance
